source.note: Built 2026-11-18 by _src/kit/make_kit_spec.py in OneDrive 'Claude's Workshop\Math builds\Grade 8 Math S2 Sparkle' from the original 1205070-s2 spec. Sparkle = the integrated redesign of Semester 2 (Modules 7-12); the original ships unchanged in 1205070-s2. Module and item titles, order and sub-headers come from the original spec. Each of the 38 lessons is one 10-point PDF-upload assignment framing its page at https://optimaondemand.github.io/mj-grade-8-pre-algebra/s2-sparkle/ ; that page carries the original lesson text, the original Prior Knowledge Check as its Warm-Up tab (12 lessons; the Module 7 checks are empty in the original) and the original VR activity as an optional note, so the separate Prior Knowledge Check items and VR Lesson Resources pages are not carried. All 56 Wiris LTI assignments (38 Independent Practice, 6 Mid-Module Checks, 6 Summative Reviews, 6 Summative Assessments) are copied field for field from the original spec (tool url, quiz id, lookup uuid, points, grading type); only ids gain the ms_ prefix, and the short instruction page each one frames is a copy of the original page in s2-sparkle/wiris/ with the read-aloud player added (same wording). Gradebook groups: the original three plus Lessons; weights left for the teacher to set. Weeks: the course files carry no week pacing; week numbers here count five items a week in the original order (a lesson and its Independent Practice share a day), as in the Grade 6 sparkle kit.
